hypotheses.title: Batch 39: Spectacular Fitness Elevation (Targeting Fitness >= 1.50+)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Alpha 12 was successfully secured with 8/8 PASS on Card 2 (Sharpe 1.41, Fitness 1.04). Card 3 achieved raw Sharpe 1.52. To fulfill the researcher's goal of achieving Fitness >= 1.50+ ('GOOD' to 'EXCELLENT' status), Batch 39 injects the agile 3-day market-maker liquidity reversal overlay (-0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 3)/close, ...)) into both proven drivers. In historical backtests, this exact compound architecture propelled Alpha 10 to Fitness 1.53 (Sharpe 1.96), Alpha 5 to Fitness 1.66 (Sharpe 1.73), and Crown Jewel ff15b378 to Fitness 1.55 (Sharpe 2.16). By capturing short-term liquidity overshoots while preserving core fundamental and volatility conviction, returns expand and turnover remains clamped in the optimal 12-16% window, mathematically driving Fitness past 1.50.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if short-term price reversal blunts longer-term volatility or EBITDA drift.
